description: Find which US employers sponsor the most H-1B visas for a given job title (optionally in a specific city) — a candidate-sourcing / target-account signal for recruiting. Answers 'which companies sponsor the most data engineers in Austin' or 'top H-1B sponsors for nurses'. Returns employers ranked by certified LCA filings for the role, each with their filing count and median base salary. Backed by real DOL LCA disclosures.

city.description: Optional work city to scope to, e.g. "AUSTIN" or "NEW YORK".

job_title.description: Job title to rank sponsors for, e.g. "data engineer", "physical therapist".

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2024). Defaults to the most recent full year.

name: h1b_top_sponsors
title: H1b Top Sponsors
